description: Lists the tags used on the team's workouts or programs. Use when the user wants to see, reuse or filter by existing tags. Not for workout categories (use list_workout_categories). Returns the distinct tag names.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

type.description: What to act on: workout = a single workout; program = a multi-week program.

name: list_content_tags
title: List content tags
